findings: Remove the claimed L000 prerequisite or replace it only with actual learned evidence. The bound learner state has completed_entries=[] and the known closure has lesson_evidence=[] and eligible_vocabulary=[]; the candidate itself says compiled L000 is only a readiness receipt, yet prerequisites asserts L000 using the compiled-manifest hash as evidence. That is not learner-lineage prerequisite evidence.

Complete the immutable planning bindings before rehearsal unlock. The accepted material-scope decision is not hash-bound in source_bindings, the lesson pattern is named only by pattern_id rather than an exact path and SHA-256, and rehearsal.qualification_record_path/sha256 are null. Bind the exact accepted scope artifact, executable lesson-pattern artifact, and applicable Instructor qualification-state artifact; do not treat the qualification policy document as the qualification record.

Repair the local presentations and add an explicit language-safe understanding check. Although each named presentation block is adjacent to its controlled gate, the affirmative worked items invoke SHOW_LABEL_SELECT_MATCHING_IMAGE without freezing both image options or the demonstrated correct selection, and the OR worked items invoke SHOW_IMAGE_SELECT_ONE_OF_TWO_LABELS without freezing the two labels or demonstrated selection; the negative worked items likewise do not encode a discrete correct-option emission. A zero-system learner cannot infer these interface operations from a label/image pair. Materialize each worked demonstration as deterministic turn-level machine controls with all operands and correct-option actions, then bind at least one explicit CHECK_UNDERSTANDING exercise/action before scored reliance on the interface convention. Keep learner-facing language to the eight labels.

Replace the mixed-practice order with a frozen seed or enumerated permutation that actually breaks cadence. The current sequence is exactly affirmative, negative, W, OR for cup, then the same four-family cycle for each successive label, so operation and item are fully predictable rather than mixed kreuz-und-quer practice. Preserve all 32 item contracts but interleave labels and families without this repeated cycle or immediate family grouping.

Reject and regenerate the picture-book visuals; the exact pixels contradict the frozen scene facts and continuity claims. Page 2 omits the plate; page 3 omits the glass; page 4 omits the glass and napkin; page 5 omits the glass; page 6 omits the knife; and page 8 omits the napkin, despite every page claiming exactly one of all eight objects remains visible. Page 1 shows six dashed positions, not the asserted eight. Pages 6-7 also switch to a different wood surface, scale, crop, arrangement, and visibly different object realizations, then page 8 switches back, so they cannot be the same persistent objects in one continuous event. Commission a fresh continuity-safe sequence whose every page independently passes exact-count, identity, active-focus, position-count, and adjacent-state checks; derive and hash fresh literal crops and update every affected claim and receipt.

Rebuild story comprehension after the visual repair and explicitly teach/check its nonverbal operation. SHOW_STORY_PAGE_SELECT_ACTIVE_OBJECT_LABEL relies on the previously unknown notion and interface convention of selecting the single active/moving object, but there is no frozen worked example or understanding check for that operation. The checks also reuse the exact just-captioned page, so they establish at most immediate same-image label association, not comprehension of the claimed state change. Add a deterministic worked adjacent-page/active-focus demonstration plus an unscored understanding check, then use corrected pages and a closed question set that validly distinguishes comprehension of the micro-event from simple caption recall while scoring only the eight licensed labels.

Make alarm/freeze execution complete and deterministic. adaptive.alarm names ALARM_FREEZE, but ALARM is absent from controller_actions, while BACKTRACK is allowed with no release rule, target phase, budget, or stop rule. The alarm triggers also omit required automatic/runtime cases including malformed alternation, unlicensed action/tool, budget breach, role-boundary failure, prompt echo/copying, perseveration, degeneration, concept bleed, abrupt state discontinuity, and persistent silence. Add executable ALARM, remove or fully specify BACKTRACK, freeze a transition table, and cover every mandatory harness and learner-pathology freeze condition with no post-alarm transition.

Reconcile teacher-turn accounting with the global budget and replay policy. There is no turn_accounting contract even though presentation exercises contain eight teacher_turns plus bulk worked machine controls and story pages contain multiple display turns. Under the rehearsal rule that every scored or worked machine emission consumes a teacher-turn unit, even the conservative base path is at least 130 units (32 local model items, 32 controlled, 32 mixed, 10 story pages, 16 comprehension/transfer, 8 recap); the permitted full REPLAY_LESSON therefore requires at least 260 units and cannot fit maximum_teacher_turns=240, before any PRESENT_AGAIN, TRAIN_MORE, TRAIN_LONGER, caption, or understanding-check units. Freeze an exact per-emission accounting model and choose mutually executable budgets and release priorities.

Repair intervention semantics and failed-item targeting. PRESENT_AGAIN proceeds to the next unscored item instead of administering the required mapped immediate cold retest of the failed item. TRAIN_MORE reuses the same bank-v2 assets already used in controlled practice, covers only cup, plate, fork, and knife, and releases that fixed subset from an aggregate gate score even when other labels failed, so it neither adds fresh reviewed material nor remediates the observed item. TRAIN_LONGER cycles only cup and plate in the same a/n/w/o cadence and has no failure-sensitive release/pass predicate. Bind gate-and-item-specific replay/retest mappings; either provide genuinely additional pre-reviewed variants for every eligible failed label or remove TRAIN_MORE; and freeze a balanced, cadence-breaking TRAIN_LONGER order with an explicit trigger, denominator, success rule, and stop outcome.

Do not unlock rehearsal from this artifact. The 24 reference crops are exact parent crops, hash-valid, complete, and visually unambiguous, and all ten story-page files are exact declared crops; however exact cropping does not rescue false source pixels, incomplete story operands, missing interface grounding, or the unexecutable controller/budget paths above. Produce a new linked candidate and fresh review after the owning visual and assembly stages repair these bytes.
